planets.name: TrES-3 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of Pipoltr with a 1.31-day year, found in 2007.

text.card: TrES-3 b was found in 2007 by TrES as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around Pipoltr. Its orbit and size follow Sozzetti et al. 2009's fit, the archive's default.
text.locator: NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table, default parameter set (pl_refname SOZZETTI_ET_AL__2009): disc_year 2007, disc_facility TrES, sy_pnum 1; pl_orbper 1.30618626966, pl_radj 1.336, pl_bmassj 1.91

quotes.title: TrES-3b
quotes.card: TrES-3b is an extrasolar planet orbiting the star GSC 03089-00929.
quotes.introduction: It has an orbital period of just 31 hours and nearly twice the mass of Jupiter.
